name: currencylayer
summary: Live and historical foreign exchange rates for 170+ currencies and precious metals, with conversion, time frames and rate changes.

api_key.description: A currencylayer API access key (account dashboard). Sent as the access_key query parameter.

notes: The default source currency is USD; switching it needs the Basic plan or higher.
Errors come back as JSON with success false and an error object (code, type, info); check success, not only the HTTP status.
Plan gates: convert Basic+, timeframe Enterprise+, change Enterprise+, spread Enterprise+.

endpoints.name: Get live exchange rates
endpoints.summary: Latest quotes for every currency (or the ones asked for) against the source currency.

source.description: Source (base) currency, 3-letter code; default USD. Basic plan and higher.

currencies.description: Comma-separated 3-letter codes to limit the quotes returned.

spread.description: 1 adds bid and ask to each quote. Enterprise plan or higher.

notes: Refreshed daily on Free, hourly on Basic, every 10 minutes on Enterprise and every 60 seconds on Enterprise+.
Quotes are keyed by the joined pair, e.g. USDEUR.

endpoints.name: Get exchange rates for a past date
endpoints.summary: End-of-day quotes for one date, back to 1999 for most currencies.

source.description: Source (base) currency, 3-letter code; default USD. Basic plan and higher.

currencies.description: Comma-separated 3-letter codes to limit the quotes returned.

spread.description: 1 adds bid and ask to each quote. Enterprise plan or higher.

notes: A date before a currency was added fails the whole call with currency_not_available_on_date.

endpoints.name: Convert an amount between currencies
endpoints.summary: Converts an amount at the live rate, or at a past date's rate, returning the rate used.

endpoints.name: Get daily rates over a date range
endpoints.summary: Daily quotes between two dates, at most 365 days apart.

source.description: Source (base) currency, 3-letter code; default USD. Basic plan and higher.

currencies.description: Comma-separated 3-letter codes to limit the quotes returned.

spread.description: 1 adds bid and ask to each quote. Enterprise plan or higher.

notes: Limit currencies: an unfiltered year of every currency is very large.

endpoints.name: Get rate changes between two dates
endpoints.summary: Start rate, end rate, absolute and percent change per currency.

start_date.description: First date, YYYY-MM-DD. Without dates, yesterday's close is compared with the latest rate.

source.description: Source (base) currency, 3-letter code; default USD. Basic plan and higher.

currencies.description: Comma-separated 3-letter codes to limit the quotes returned.
